subject: Tenant activation: procurement questions + API/project keying ramp
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@crestlinehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: acct_ops@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant activation, procurement questions and API keying ramp

Hi Kimberly / Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team at Crestline is ready to move into tenant activation once procurement is finalized. A few items we need clarified before we lock dates:

- PO & billing: Our finance team just sent the PO (attached). Can you confirm the billing contact and invoice cadence?
- Project namespace: We plan to map Redwood projects to our existing environment prefixes (crestline-prod, crestline-stg). Is there any restriction on characters or max length?
- API keys & service accounts: We need a recommended approach for seeding service accounts and API keys for both staging and prod. We anticipate 3 service accounts (ingest, inference, monitoring) and want to understand rotation requirements.
- Role mapping & admin seats: We'll have ~6 admin users and ~20 standard users to start. Can you share a default roles matrix or a template?

Attached: Crestline_PO_9876.pdf

We'd like to target activation week of Oct 4 if that works on your side.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Platform Engineering
Crestline Health

---

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@crestlinehealth.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation, procurement questions and API keying ramp

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the PO. We'll move this forward. Quick answers up front and a proposed runbook below.

Billing / PO: Ben (cc'd) will confirm the billing contact and invoice cadence. We can invoice monthly or net-30 per the PO.

Project namespace: We support alphanumeric, hyphens, and underscores; max 48 characters. Your prefixes (crestline-prod / crestline-stg) are fine. We'll reserve those names once we receive the completed provisioning template.

API keys & service accounts (high level):
- Approach: We recommend provisioning dedicated service accounts per environment and seeding ephemeral API keys via our Console. Keys can be rotated programmatically; minimum recommended rotation is 90 days unless you have stricter policy.
- Initial seed schedule:
  * Staging: seed on Oct 1 (service accounts: ingest-stg, inference-stg, monitor-stg)
  * Prod: seed on Oct 4 after completed tenant activation (ingest-prod, inference-prod, monitor-prod)
- Rotation options: We can enable automated rotation using your KMS (we support AWS KMS / GCP KMS). Vivek can propose a rotation script.

Roles matrix: See attached provisioning template (redwood_provisioning_template.xlsx). Fill in user emails, intended roles, and admin seats — we'll validate and create the roster.

Proposed activation runbook (short):
1) Oct 1: Staging namespace reserved + staging keys seeded; smoke tests run by Crestline.
2) Oct 2: Security questionnaire (if needed) and evidence upload to shared Drive.
3) Oct 4: Prod namespace reserved; prod keys seeded after purchase order accepted and billing contact confirmed.
4) Oct 5-6: Production cutover window + post-activation support (Vivek on call).

Attachments: redwood_provisioning_template.xlsx (please complete and return by Sep 29)

Ben will follow up on PO/payment cadence and Vivek will share a short rotation script and monitoring alerts. If Oct 4 is tight, we can move to Oct 11.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success (Commercial)
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@crestlinehealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation, procurement questions and API keying ramp

Elena — adding a few technical clarifications that will help your infra/ops team.

1) Service accounts & keys: We'll create service accounts in the tenant and generate initial API keys via the Redwood Console. Keys are symmetric tokens (bearer style). If you want short-lived tokens backed by your KMS, we can enable a delegation flow — requires an IAM role and a small bootstrap script (attached as a gist link below).

2) Network/firewall: If you plan to restrict egress to our hosted endpoints, provide the IP ranges (we will provide a CIDR block list). For Dedicated or Private deployments we'd coordinate differently.

3) Monitoring & alerting: We'll configure one monitoring webhook for the "monitor" service account. Alert runbooks can be added to the shared Drive document.

4) Rotation script & example: https://gist.github.com/vivek/rotation-bootstrap-crestline (one-file bash + curl sample).

On-call: I'm available for the Oct 4 activation window; I'll join the call and can perform key seeding and smoke checks.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@crestlinehealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation, procurement questions and API keying ramp

Elena — thanks for the PO and for confirming the initial seat counts on the call. Quick summary and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary:
- PO received (reference: Crestline_PO_9876). Ben will send formal billing contact and confirm net-30.
- Project namespaces reserved: crestline-stg (reserved Oct 1) and crestline-prod (reserved Oct 4).
- Service accounts to be created: ingest-*, inference-*, monitor-* for both envs.
- Red team / security: Please upload the completed security questionnaire to the shared Drive link by Sep 29.

Action items & owners:
- Crestline: complete and return redwood_provisioning_template.xlsx by EOD Sep 29 (Elena).
- Ben: billing contact + invoice cadence confirmation (by Sep 28).
- Vivek: post rotation script link and be on-call for Oct 4 activation (confirmed).
- Kimberly: reserve activation slots and coordinate the calendar with Crestline (done).

SLA & signature: I sent the DocuSign link for our standard activation SLA to the email in your PO. Please sign by Sep 30 so we can proceed with prod seeding Oct 4. Link: https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123 (also included in related_links).

If you prefer Oct 11 instead, say so in reply — otherwise we are penciled for Oct 4-5 for prod activation and Oct 1 for staging.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth activation week.

Warmly,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
